name: Osanai Chika
source:
A young wife who has been married for two years.

When she was in college, she met her husband, a graduate of the same university, at a school where she was on a teaching internship for her teaching course.

Her maiden name is Shimbada.

Her parents live in Chiba, and she has an older brother who is married and has one child. She would like to get a car license soon, but she is mechanically inept with no sense of direction. She is the type of person who likes to cherish anniversaries.

[from [url=http://autobahn69.jp/Autobahn/buai.html] official site]
